body: Your feelings and your drive move together, so you act on what you feel without a lot of static. You're emotionally honest and quick to stand up for the people you love. Instinct and action line up. When something's wrong, you say it; when someone needs defending, you move. It's a clean, alive way to be. The only catch is heat: the same wiring that makes you honest can make you reactive when you're not paying attention. Stay awake to it and your passion becomes courage.
gift: At your best: passionate, honest, quick to protect what you love.
shadow: The trap: letting the same heat that makes you honest tip into reactive.
integration: Let emotional needs and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity.
do: Say the feeling cleanly while it's still useful
Aim the heat at protecting, not punishing
Stay awake to the reactive edge
